title: The half magnetic Drude parameter lies in the essential spectrum of the augmented operator for polygonal two-material cavities with nonintersecting interfaces
author: Christophe Hazard; Sandrine Paolantoni
work: Spectral analysis of polygonal cavities containing a negative-index material
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.58
difficulty_reason: The source constructs Fourier superpositions of exponentially confined interface waves, verifies the nonstandard coupled transmission operator domain, and proves concentration with a nonvanishing gradient norm and weak convergence to create an essential-spectrum Weyl sequence. This spectral resonance mechanism for a dispersive augmented PDE operator exceeds ordinary qualifying problems.
